name: Pitch Shifter
description: Two pitch-shifted voices in three characters, clean, grainy or fluttering, with a delay and feedback that make the repeats climb or fall.

params.name: Pitch A
params.description: The interval of the first voice above or below what is played. It glides when moved, so it can be played like a pitch pedal.

params.name: Pitch B
params.description: The interval of the second voice. It is silent until Voice B is raised.

params.name: Voice B
params.description: How loud the second voice is beside the first. Zero leaves a single shifted voice.

params.name: Detune
params.description: Pushes voice A a little sharp and voice B a little flat. With both pitches at zero it is a doubler that thickens the sound.

params.name: Mode
params.description: The character of the shift. Smooth lines its splices up with the sound and stays clean, Grain rebuilds it from overlapping grains, Vintage splices blindly and flutters.

params.name: Size
params.description: The length of the pieces the shifter works with. Short is tight in time and rougher, down to a metallic buzz in Grain; long is smoother and looser.

params.name: Jitter
params.description: Scatters each grain or splice in time and pitch. A little loosens the shift into a chorus; a lot turns it into a noisy cloud.

params.name: Delay
params.description: How late the shifted voices arrive. With Feedback it is the gap between repeats.

params.name: Feedback
params.description: Sends the shifted voices back in through the delay, so each repeat is shifted again and climbs or falls. With no delay it thickens into a shimmer.

params.name: Tone
params.description: Darkens the shifted voices. It sits in the feedback path too, so each repeat is duller than the last.

params.name: Spread
params.description: Moves voice A to the left and voice B to the right. Zero keeps both in the middle.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the dry signal and the shifted voices.
